B: Hiya, hello. Can you hear me alright?
A: Yeah, hi. Yeah, I can hear you.
B: Lovely. I'm Julie, I'm in Ossett, that's West Yorkshire.
A: I'm Kerry. Stowmarket, in Suffolk.
B: Suffolk, right. Nice part of the world, that. So what do you do?
A: Erm, I'm an office admin at a plumbing and heating firm. Part-time.
B: Oh, so trade, same as me, sort of. I'm a regional operations manager for a builders' merchants, six branches across West and South Yorkshire. We do a lot with plumbers, so I know what they're like for paying their invoices.
A: Oh, tell me about it. I'm chasing invoices half the week.
B: It's never-ending, isn't it. Is it a big firm?
A: No, it's family-run. It's the boss and his wife, and the lads. I order all the bits from the merchants, so I'm probably ringing someone like you.
B: Probably ringing one of my branch managers and giving him earache. Good. Keeps them on their toes.
A: Ha, yeah. I'm quite nice about it, to be fair.
B: That's the way, catch more flies with honey. So, have you got family?
A: Yeah, husband, Darren, and two kids, Ellie's twelve and Josh is nine. Darren's an electrician, self-employed.
B: You're joking, so's mine! Gary. Self-employed sparky. Never home before seven.
A: Same. And when it's quiet it's really quiet, you know.
B: Oh, I know. Gary's always worrying about money even when we're fine. Drives me mad.
A: Yeah, so...
B: Erm, mine are grown up now. Callum's twenty-two, in Leeds, and Megan's at uni in Nottingham. So it's just us and the dog.
A: Oh, that must be strange.
B: It is, a bit, I won't lie. You get used to it. More time for the gym, in theory. Did you do that puzzle at the start?
A: Yeah. I didn't get far.
B: No, I thought it was a bit pointless, to be honest. I'd rather just get on and talk to people. That's what I'm good at.
A: Yeah, I'm better at talking than puzzles.
B: So what do you do for fun, Kerry, when you're not chasing plumbers?
A: Erm, not much really, telly mostly. Married at First Sight, Love Island. I do my nails. Sunday dinner at my mum's.
B: Oh, I watch all of that. I'm a Gogglebox girl, and I'm a Celeb. Gary rolls his eyes but he's sat there watching it with me by the end.
A: Darren's the same, to be fair. He pretends he isn't watching.
B: They all do. Do you get away much? Holidays?
A: We do a caravan at Hemsby most summers. And we've been to Tenerife twice, all-inclusive.
B: Tenerife! We go every year near enough. Which bit were you?
A: Erm, the south, I think, near Los Cristianos. Sorry, I'm terrible with names.
